newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Heads found in Nigerian church as riots continue.
newsitem.headline: Heads found in Nigerian church as riots continue.

text.p: Two human heads were discovered inside a church as rioting continued in the eastern Nigerian city of Owerri, local newspapers said on Thursday.

"Several hundred youths defied a state of emergency in their determined fight against ritual murders and other criminals even as government imposed a 6 p.m. (1700 GMT) to 6 a.m. (0500 GMT) curfew," The Champion newspaper said.
The pentecostal Overcomers Church, which the crowd said had been financed by a fraudster, was burned to the ground after the heads were found inside.
The Daily Times said more than 25 buildings and 30 cars had been set on fire by the demonstrators.
Rioting began on Tuesday with the discovery of a boy's headless corpse in a shallow grave near a hotel. His suspected killer died in police custody at the weekend.
